Author: Krishan Pahal

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1663 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Mamta Rani And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Bhuvnesh Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Deepak Kumar Pal
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Sri Bhuvnesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Deepak Kumar Pal,
learned counsel for the informant and Sri R.M. Yadav, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.

The present application has been moved seeking anticipatory bail in Complaint Case no. 2242 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406, 323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Dhampur, District- Bijnor, with the prayer to enlarge them on anticipatory bail.

The present complaint case was filed by the informant alleging that the applicants are stated to have got the agricultural land and residential land of the informant registered in his name without any consideration, whatsoever.
Learned counsel for the applicants has argued that the applicants are absolutely innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present case with a view to cause unnecessary harassment and to victimize them.

Learned counsel has next stated that as even the mutation proceedings are complete Smt. Mamta Rani And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45819381/
1 and the informant has not levelled any allegations against the applicants therein.

entities.text: Smt. Mamta Rani And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel has also stated that the applicants and the informant are relatives and with the passage of time,
when the value of the land escalated, he has lodged the present complaint case.
There is no criminal history of the applicants.
The charge sheet has been filed.
There is no possibility of the applicants influencing the trial or tampering with the evidence.
It is further stated that applicants are co-operating in the trial and are ready to cooperate in future also.
There is no likelihood of the applicants repeating the said offence, if any.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicants to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against them.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicants have also been touched upon at length.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but unable to dispute the fact that the mutation proceedings are complete and that the applicants have no criminal history.

On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-(2020) 5 SCC 1", the applicants are entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case.

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi)-(2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

entities.text: Mamta Rani And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.
